sponsorPool.description: Optional durable application sponsor pool. Multiple distinct payers may share one client; selected payers remain pinned on retries, unknown attempts occupy capacity and lifetime budgets remain shared.

safeQueue.description: Optional bounded per-Safe FIFO of exact unsigned requests for delayed execution. Only the head receives a verified current nonce and immutable action; all original authority checks remain mandatory.

recovery.description: Optional read-only stuck-transaction diagnostics and durable payer quarantine. Nonce and pending visibility are operational evidence; repair mutations remain separately authorized provider procedures.
